rationale: The Workshop Door sensor (SEN-D1) is bound correctly in both base and app, has compatible firmware (v3 supported), good RSSI (-60 dBm) and 75% battery, yet remains offline. With a brand-new battery inserted and the SYNC button held for 3 seconds right next to the base station, the LED stayed completely dark (no blue, no red) — a functioning sensor would at minimum light its LED on power-up/reset. This indicates a hardware fault in the sensor itself, not a signal, battery, binding, or firmware issue.

HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.
